lessons_used: Layout changes to path selection stages were helpful and significantly improved conversion.
Interactive walkthrough redesigns, new adoption flows, and sign-in reassurance hints significantly hurt conversion.
Reordering steps, copy changes, wait-time info, photo upload guidance, and sign-in card layout changes showed no clear effect.
Predictions were consistently too high for walkthrough redesigns, new flows, reassurance hints, copy changes, and reordering.
Predictions were too low for path selection layout changes, underestimating their actual positive impact.

guard.reason: Redesigning the story screen layout inside onboarding is allowed and maintains the screen's core job.

candidates.score_note: Path selection layout changes have proven effective at improving conversion.
